frames.narration: The client asks a Tea to prepare itself. prepare() is defined once, in the base class.
Steps 1 and 3 are the same for every drink, so the base class implements them itself.
Step 2 differs, so the base class calls the abstract brew(), which Tea overrides.
Step 4 is optional. The base asks a hook, wantsCondiments(); Tea keeps the default (yes) and adds lemon.
Now a Coffee. Same prepare(), same order, written nowhere else.
Coffee overrides brew() with its own method.
Coffee overrides the hook to say no condiments, so step 4 is skipped. The order itself never changed.
